description: This file defines a React component for a comparison UI in a chat-based application, allowing users to compare different models, agents, or configurations via a multi-panel interface with message input, file upload, and control options.

methods.name: compareUI
methods.description: Main React component implementing a comparison chat UI with multiple configurable panels, message handling, file uploads, and model/agent selection.

methods.name: addComparison
methods.description: Adds a new comparison panel with default or fallback model and agent.

methods.name: removeComparison
methods.description: Removes a comparison panel by id.

methods.name: updateComparison
methods.description: Updates properties of a comparison panel by id, optionally applying shared updates across all comparisons.

methods.name: handleFileUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading and preview URL creation for a file attachment.

methods.name: handleRemoveFile
methods.description: Removes uploaded file and revokes object URL.

methods.name: clearAllChats
methods.description: Clears message history and resets comparison states.

methods.name: appendAssistantChunk
methods.description: Appends a chunk of text to the last message from the assistant in a comparison.

methods.name: appendReasoningContent
methods.description: Appends reasoning content to the last assistant message or creates a new message with reasoning content.

methods.name: updateTimingDataForComparison
methods.description: Updates timing (e.g., time to first token) for a comparison.

methods.name: updateTotalLatencyForComparison
methods.description: Updates total latency data for a comparison.

methods.name: updateUsageDataForComparison
methods.description: Updates token usage and tool information for a comparison.

methods.name: updateSearchResultsForComparison
methods.description: Updates search results in the comparison's state.

methods.name: handleSendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending user input message, preparing API requests, updating UI states, and handling errors.

methods.name: handleFollowUpSelect
methods.description: Sets selected follow-up prompt as message input.
